questions.q_en: What is special about your solution in biomanufacturing?
questions.q_zh: 你們的方案在生物製造上特別在哪裡？
questions.a_en: Production, recovery and containment are one unit operation: the same 0.2 micrometre hollow-fibre wall that holds the cells in is the wall the product crosses to leave, so there is no separate downstream step and nothing is lysed. It runs at the point of use, so the protectant never enters a cold chain, and keeping the organism in the machine splits the regulation in two — contained use for the strain, and a plant-biostimulant route for the cell-free output. We also had to build our own instruments because nobody sells them at one litre: an in-line photometer that read a 434-hour culture with no sample withdrawn, and a signal-processing study whose eleven algorithms and eight predictions were committed to the repository before the calibration run. What I would not claim is titre: 2.5 to 6.5 micrograms per millilitre on the shell side is low for a bioprocess, and longer runs do not mean bigger harvests.
questions.a_zh: 生產、回收和圍阻是同一個單元操作：那層把細胞擋住的 0.2 微米中空纖維壁，也正是產品穿出去的那道壁，所以沒有獨立的下游步驟，也不需要把細胞打破。它在使用現場運轉，所以保護蛋白從來不進冷鏈；而把生物體留在機器裡，等於把法規切成兩條路——菌株走封閉使用，無細胞產出走植物生物刺激劑或肥料。我們也必須自己做儀器，因為一公升這個尺度沒有人賣：一台在 434 小時裡不抽一次樣的線上光度計，以及一份在校正實驗之前就把十一個演算法和八個預測提交進版本庫的訊號處理研究。我不會主張的是效價：殼側 2.5 到 6.5 微克每毫升，對一個生物製程來說是低的，而且跑得更久不代表收得更多。
questions.trap_en: Claiming hollow-fibre perfusion as the novelty. It is not new; the claim is the three functions in one unit operation at this scale, with the instruments and the pre-registration.
questions.trap_zh: 把中空纖維灌流當成新穎之處。那不是新東西；主張是「在這個尺度上三個功能合成一個單元操作」，加上儀器和預先登記。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: You claim you are developing a decentralised bioreactor for everyone to use. What is the advantage, and what is the disadvantage?
questions.q_zh: 你們說要做一台讓每個人都能用的去中心化生物反應器。優點是什麼，缺點是什麼？
kw_en: no cold chain, fresh and known dose
kw_zh: 沒有冷鏈、新鮮且劑量已知
沒有田間試驗、沒有 TEA
questions.a_en: The advantage is that the protectant is made on the day it is needed, so there is no refrigerated storage, no refrigerated transport and no shelf life to manage, and the farmer buys a consumable rather than a cold-chain product. The disadvantage is that every farm then needs its own machine: capital is US$2,280 per hectare in the business plan and US$3,800 in our own Math Model, and the maintenance, sterility and leak-watching move to someone who is not a microbiologist. We have no field trial and no techno-economic analysis, and our own model's payback at efficacy one is sixty-eight years against the Geospatial analysis's 4.9 — a factor of fourteen our pages name and do not resolve. That is why the plan is five to ten pilot units for one growing season before any sale, and why cooperative purchase, seasonal rental and a cartridge subscription are all still on the table.
questions.a_zh: 優點是保護蛋白在需要的那一天才製造，所以沒有冷藏儲存、沒有冷藏運輸、沒有效期要管，而農民買的是消耗品而不是冷鏈產品。缺點是每個農場都要一台機器：商業計畫裡每公頃資本是 US$2,280，我們自己的數學模型算出來是 US$3,800，而維護、無菌和盯洩漏這些工作會落到一個不是微生物學家的人身上。我們沒有田間試驗也沒有技術經濟分析，而我們自己模型在效力為 1 時的回收期是六十八年，對上地理空間分析的 4.9 年——相差十四倍，我們頁面上把這件事指出來、但沒有解決。這也是為什麼計畫是先做五到十台試驗機、跑一個生長季再談銷售，以及為什麼合作社共購、季節租賃和卡匣訂閱都還在選項裡。
questions.trap_en: Giving a soft disadvantage like farmers need training. The real ones are the capital per hectare, the payback disagreement, and that no unit has ever run on a farm.
questions.trap_zh: 給一個軟性的缺點，例如「農民需要訓練」。真正的缺點是每公頃資本、回收期的不一致，以及從來沒有一台機器真的在農場上運轉過。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: If I wanted to scale up the bioreactor instead of using multiple units, what factors should be considered?
questions.q_zh: 如果我要把反應器放大，而不是用很多台，要考慮哪些因素？
kw_en: wall shear sets the critical flux
kw_zh: 每個跟尺度有關的量都要重做
壁面剪切決定臨界通量
questions.a_en: Scaling up one vessel means re-establishing every quantity that depends on a length scale: oxygen transfer, where we need a kLa of 12.5 per hour at OD 1.45, heat removal, mixing time, membrane area per unit volume, and the wall shear rate that sets the critical flux and the fouling margin. We scale out instead, because tangential-flow filtration has a formal linear method — hold wall shear and transmembrane pressure constant, increase only the channel count — and a scale-down hollow-fibre module has the same fibre length as an industrial one, so our module is the unit cell to be replicated. Worked from one module to eight, the membrane is the last thing to bind; what binds first is medium draw at 0.96 rising to 7.7 litres a day, eight continuous cross-flow pumps, and energy from 3 to 8 watts rising to 24 to 64 against a 45 watt panel that harvests 101 watt-hours a day. Running the recirculation pump on a duty cycle relieves three of those four at once, and the cost is settling in the fibres during the off phase, which is the first experiment we would run.
questions.a_zh: 放大單一容器意味著每一個跟尺度有關的量都要重新建立：氧氣傳遞（OD 1.45 時我們需要 kLa 12.5 每小時）、散熱、混合時間、單位體積的膜面積，以及決定臨界通量和結垢餘裕的壁面剪切速率。我們改成平行複製，因為切向流過濾有一套正式的線性放大方法——固定壁面剪切和跨膜壓，只增加通道數——而且縮小型中空纖維模組和工業型的纖維長度相同，所以我們的模組本身就是要被複製的單元。從一個模組推到八個，膜是最後才成為限制的；先成為限制的是培養基用量（0.96 升／天升到 7.7）、八台連續運轉的切向流泵，以及能耗（3 到 8 瓦升到 24 到 64 瓦，而一片 45 瓦的太陽能板一天收 101 瓦時）。把循環泵改成間歇運轉可以一次緩解其中三項，代價是停泵期間纖維內的沉降，那就是我們會先做的實驗。
questions.trap_en: Listing scale-up factors without saying we chose scale-out and why. The method, not the list, is the answer.
questions.trap_zh: 把放大的因素列一串，但沒說我們選了平行複製以及為什麼。答案是那套方法，不是清單。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: Have you tested how long the protectant lasts before it is delivered to the crop? Could it degrade before it reaches the plant?
questions.q_zh: 你們測過保護蛋白在送到作物之前能撐多久嗎？會不會在到達植物之前就降解掉？
kw_en: inside the machine, yes, to 72 hours
kw_zh: 機器內有，撐到 72 小時
採收後的製劑從沒測過
0.7 到 1.5 小時 vs 八小時上升
questions.a_en: Inside the machine, yes: the shell permeate held ACC deaminase above 2 micrograms per millilitre through seventy-two hours, and specific activity sat between 5 and 8.4 units per milligram from eighteen hours to the end of the run, so it is not falling apart in the reactor. Outside the machine, no, and this is one of our declared gaps. Our two stability readings point opposite ways: one tube fell from 0.5503 to 0.1414 millimolar alpha-ketobutyrate between three and six hours, giving an apparent half-time of 0.7 to 1.5 hours, while a replicated run rose across its first eight hours — and the tube that fell was read once. Neither measured a harvested preparation, which is the quantity that decides whether stock can be banked, and that matters because ten twenty-litre reactors need 5.4 days to make one hectare's dose against a three-day forecast, so the system has to run on banked stock; if it cannot be banked, stabilisation becomes the limiting problem.
questions.a_zh: 在機器裡面有：殼側透過液的 ACC 去胺酶在七十二小時內都維持在 2 微克每毫升以上，比活性從十八小時到實驗結束都在 5 到 8.4 U/mg 之間，所以它在反應器裡並沒有崩掉。在機器外面沒有，而這是我們自己列出來的缺口。我們兩個穩定性讀值方向相反：有一管在三到六小時之間從 0.5503 掉到 0.1414 毫莫耳 α-ketobutyrate，推出 0.7 到 1.5 小時的表觀半衰期，而另一次有重複的實驗在前八小時是上升的——而掉下來那一管只讀了一次。兩者都不是在測「採收後的製劑」，而那才是決定能不能備庫的量；這件事很重要，因為十台二十公升的反應器需要 5.4 天才能做出一公頃的用量，而預報只看得到三天，所以系統必須靠備庫運轉。如果不能備庫，穩定化就會變成限制性的問題。
questions.trap_en: Answering only with the 72-hour reactor data. The question is about the harvested material in a tank or an irrigation line, and that has never been measured.
questions.trap_zh: 只用反應器 72 小時的數據回答。問題問的是採收後在桶子或灌溉管線裡的材料，而那從來沒有被量過。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: Name the two links in your chain that have never been demonstrated.
questions.q_zh: 說出你們整條鏈上從來沒有被展示過的兩個環節。
kw_en: each has a smallest closing experiment
kw_zh: 各有一個最小的收口實驗
questions.a_en: Forecast to light, and permeate to irrigation. No forecast has ever driven a light that reached a culture — the models were scored on recorded runs and the green strip was never fitted inside the reactor, so that stage is not joined to the next end to end. And every plant trial applied the material by hand, so the irrigation line with its mixing point and drip emitters is a design, not a result. The smallest experiment that closes the first is one reactor run where the stress index sets the lamp level automatically and the light is logged alongside OD and activity; for the second it is one hydroponic bed fed from the shell side through the mixing point, with the protectant measured at the emitter rather than at the reactor.
questions.a_zh: 預測到燈，以及透過液到灌溉。從來沒有任何一次預測驅動的燈照到過培養液——模型是在已記錄的實驗上評分的，而綠光燈條也從來沒有裝進反應器本體，所以這一段和下一段並沒有端到端接起來。另外每一次植物試驗都是手動施用，所以那條帶著混合點和滴灌出水口的灌溉管線是一個設計，不是一個結果。收掉第一個的最小實驗是：跑一次反應器，讓逆境指數自動決定燈的強度，並把光照和 OD、活性一起記錄下來；第二個則是用殼側經過混合點去餵一張水耕床，並且在出水口而不是在反應器量保護蛋白。
questions.trap_en: Naming weak links instead of missing ones. These two are absent, not weak, and a judge values hearing them volunteered.
questions.trap_zh: 講出「比較弱的環節」而不是「缺失的環節」。這兩個是完全不存在，不是弱；評審重視你主動講出來。
